scientific limitations/integrity: This is an exact finite labeled classification for the matrix in Example IV.22 of arXiv:2605.09748. It does not classify structures modulo code automorphisms, optimize \(m/L\) for arbitrary \(L\), or settle the paper's global open problem. Exhaustiveness is supplied by a standalone verifier that reconstructs all minimal recovery sets and checks every admissible \(L=2\) multiplicity vector. Focused literature searches cannot by themselves prove novelty.
title: Exactly two \((5,2)\)-strongly-online service multisets for the eight-column example
